remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1917. Work has been associated with trip O'Keeffe made to Colorado in summer 1917. Completed in Virginia before August move to Texas. See cat. no. 104. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: An amorphous green blob fills the lower right of the composition. Arching over the green form is a bright blue shape. A very pale blue shape fills the topmost portion of the image.
